steps.what: Read the last emergency drill before writing anything
Develop procedures for dealing with emergencies during practices or competitions
Test those procedures with the staff on the field

tasks.design: She reads the last drill, develops the procedures for emergencies during practices or competitions, and tests them with the staff on the field. The writing is the development itself and stays with her. Nothing is copied or sent, and she does not approve a save of her own procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: The procedure has to match the venue and the people on the field, and a wrong step can harm an athlete.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this task became a field another system can carry. She still writes the procedure and still runs the drill.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the steps and seeing whether the staff can carry them out stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the procedure. A stored sentence cannot run the drill.
tasks.altitude: Developing and testing the emergency procedures stay in her week. Nothing leaves it. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Carry out the emergency procedure she tested
reach.learn: Which steps she set for a collapse on the field

evidence.claim: Developing and testing emergency procedures is her judgement on the field, and a later save of that same procedure is not a separate sending step.

assumptions: The procedure is for this hospital's own practices and competitions. It is not a message to someone outside.
No structured input is required. She reads the last drill herself.
Writing the procedure is part of developing it and stays in her remaining time.
She does not send the procedure and does not approve her own save of it.
Upkeep hours are zero because no machine step is added.
unknowns: Whether this clinic stores the procedure inside this task or in a separate record task.
research_questions: How often a year passes with no new emergency procedure and no drill.

incremental.description: No machine step is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of procedure work stays with her. She still develops the steps and still tests them on the field.

tasks.short: Coordinate sports care with other experts.

steps.what: Read the sports care plan already agreed for this event
Coordinate sports activities with other experts including specialty physicians
State the activity and which surgeons, athletic trainers, physical therapists or coaches are asked
Copy the stated activity and expert into the message
Check the message names her activity and her expert
Send the accepted message to the outside expert

tasks.design: She coordinates the sports activities with the other experts in person, then states the activity and which surgeons, athletic trainers, physical therapists or coaches are asked. A later deterministic copy places only those fields into the message and does not choose the activity or the expert, and it does not wait for its own check. She checks that the message names her activity and her expert, and only that accepted message is sent to an expert outside the hospital. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The message had to be composed by hand, and a wrong activity or a wrong expert can harm the athlete.
tasks.enabler_now: The activity and the expert she states are enough for a field copy into the message that already leaves the hospital.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the activity and who is asked stays with her. A blank activity is not invented.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the coordination. A copied message cannot see the athlete.
tasks.altitude: The coordination meeting stays in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted message to an outside expert leaves it. She gains no right to skip the choice of activity.

reach.task: Carry out the sports activity named in the accepted message
reach.learn: Which activity she stated and which expert she asked

evidence.claim: Copying a stated activity and a named expert into a coordination message does not choose the activity or the expert.

assumptions: The athlete id is already on the event in the {OTHER} record. She does not re-key it.
Fields she states before the copy are the activity and the outside expert. A blank activity or a blank expert means no copy.
Try the record's own message before any custom copy.
The copy places only those stated fields, does not add an expert, and does not wait for its own check.
Today she writes that message herself. The machine is only the later copy and the later send.
She does not also type the message. The check compares the activity and the expert with what she stated. Any change voids acceptance.
Rejection sends nothing. The send is a written message that already goes to an expert outside the hospital. An in-house talk has no send.
The message is not uploaded to an external model. There is no ambient recording.
A rejected message is dropped in the check, so upkeep hours are zero.
unknowns: How often this coordination stays a meeting inside the hospital, with no written message to an outside expert.
research_questions: How often an event ends with no outside message, so the copy and the send do not fire.

tasks.short: Observe and evaluate athletes' mental well-being.

steps.what: Read the recent training load before any observation
Observe athletes and evaluate their mental being in person
Decide whether that mental state needs someone else

tasks.design: She reads the training load, observes the athletes and evaluates their mental state in person, and decides whether someone else is needed. Nothing is copied or sent. A later note of the evaluation is a different task, and she does not approve a save of it. There is no recording of the talk.
tasks.previous_blocker: The evaluation depends on the athlete in front of her, and a wrong reading can harm that athlete.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this task became a field another system can carry. She still watches the athlete herself.
tasks.still_hard: Judging mental well-being and deciding whether to involve someone else stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the evaluation. A stored sentence cannot see the athlete.
tasks.altitude: Observing and evaluating mental well-being stay in her week. Nothing leaves it. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Adjust the session after she has evaluated the athlete
reach.learn: Whether she judged the mental state safe to continue

evidence.claim: Observing and evaluating an athlete's mental state is in-person judgement, and a later note of that evaluation is a different task.

assumptions: The evaluation is done in person with the athlete. It is not a message to someone outside.
No structured input is required beyond the training load already on the visit. She does not re-key it.

incremental.description: No machine step is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

tasks.short: Advise when a sports practice should cease.

steps.what: Read the practice that may be harmful before advising
Advise athletes, trainers or coaches to alter or cease sports practices that are potentially harmful
State what must alter or cease and who must hear it
Copy that stated advice into the outbound message
Check the message keeps her advice and the people she named
Send the accepted advice to the outside coach

tasks.design: She advises the athletes, trainers or coaches in person, then states what must alter or cease and who must hear it. A later deterministic copy places only those fields into the message and does not choose the advice or wait for its own check.
